The orange promo flag "New" sits on the top left of the photo, the yellow warning flag "Needs check" (exclamation icon) and red error flag "Rejected" (cross icon) sit together above the title, and the grey info flags "Maintenance", "Seasonal" and "Express Available" sit below it.

314c261ced54c4dab0880382e8e0e30da2f8dd73.caption: Do example: the four dedicated STIHL battery system logos stacked vertically, each drawn as a small battery icon: AI in blue, AK System in orange, AP System in grey and AS System in green. 351a8d0dce625a4f9a0aab786c721f54276a02f6.caption: Two columns of flags with icons comparing icon types. Callout 1 marks Functional Icons (the default), used on all variants: "Approved" (check mark, success), "Plan cancels soon" (clock, warning), "Rejected" (cross, error), "In review" (document, info), "Discount" (orange highlight promo flag with a discount icon) and "Promotion" (black neutral promo flag with a tag icon). Callout 2 marks System Feedback Icons, available for the Status variants only: "Confirmed" (green filled check circle, success), "In assessment" (warning triangle, warning), "Rejected" (red diamond with exclamation mark, error) and "In review" (grey filled info circle, info).

4340df33e937881d5e663ea8aa99af28a152d35c.caption: Don't example: a card without a photo that shows two orange promo flags, "Best Seller" and "New", side by side above the grey flags "Maintenance" and "Seasonal", the title "Seasonal Tune-Up" and the text "Our most popular service for longer life and reliable power." Multiple Promo flags within a group compete with one another; a Promo flag should stand out.

Callout 3 points at the red error flag (failure, critical issue or negative outcome). Callout 4 points at the grey info flag (neutral or ongoing state, or non-semantic labels such as categories, tags or metadata).

a19ed5e1856a21342d38187ff3209557d0741131.caption: Do example: icons are used consistently within each Flag variant. Callout 1 points at a group of four flags: a yellow warning flag "Required" with an exclamation icon, followed by the icon-free grey info flags "Product information", "Seasonal" and "Battery-Powered Only". Callout 2 points at a group where an orange promo flag "New" has a bell icon, followed by the icon-free grey info flags "Product information", "Seasonal" and "Battery-Powered Only". Flags with and without icons may be used together as long as usage is consistent within each variant.

b1ec5cc0260a7b0221b3bc3fe075166526919d97.caption: Do example: a white card titled "Seasonal Tune-Up" with the text "Our most popular service for longer life and reliable power." Above the title are four Flags in two rows: two Promo Flags, a highlighted orange "Best Seller" and a neutral dark "New", followed by two light grey Flags "Maintenance" and "Seasonal". It shows the rule of a maximum of two Promo Flags per group, one highlighted and one neutral.

b43cd3ba79526d2429835b7167b827fcbadcc132.caption: Don't example: a card with a battery photo and the title "Seasonal Tune-Up", followed by too many different flag variants in one section: an orange promo flag "New", grey info flags "Maintenance", "Seasonal" and "Express Available", a yellow warning flag "Needs check" with an exclamation icon and a red error flag "Rejected" with a cross icon. This makes scanning and comprehension harder; use a maximum of two flag types per section.

c33a923a5481163f3e8143e0499b50941acf59b4.caption: Additional colors for the Flag. The standard light grey Flag "Status Info" is shown on its own in the upper row. Below it are three custom-colored Flags, each labelled "Status Info Custom": one light peach, one light purple and one pink, all with dark text. They illustrate additional label colors that stay visually distinct from the Status Flags.

c4247d8fc7c57cb843231ee4240d860755426202.caption: Combining multiple flags in one section is allowed, as long as each group has a clear, distinguishable purpose. Top row, three cards: "Seasonal Tune-Up" with a battery photo and the grey flags "Battery Health", "Maintenance", "Seasonal" and "Express Available"; "RZ Financing Program" with a photo of a person working on a chainsaw, a yellow warning flag "Required" with an exclamation icon and grey flags "Product information", "Seasonal" and "Battery-Powered Only"; and a photo-less card with an orange flag "Best Seller", grey flags "Maintenance" and "Seasonal", the title "Seasonal Tune-Up", the text "Our most popular service for longer life and reliable power." and a dark button "Make an appointment" with a calendar icon. Below, a data table with the columns "Title", "Type and Status", "Product affiliation", "Published on" and "Add to bookmark"; its rows hold small grey type flags such as "Dealer news", "Technical bulletin", "Diagnostics" and "Product information", and one small green flag "Confirmed" with a check mark.

Promo variant (callout 2): 2a is neutral (black background, white text), 2b is highlight (orange background).
